name: caimera
description: Build and run Caimera product photography workflows from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Caimera turns product photos into on-model shots, catalog images, prints and edits. With this plugin, ChatGPT can build and run Caimera Workflows for you: describe the pipeline you want ("put each product on a model, then make three angles"), and ChatGPT creates it on your Caimera canvas, checks the credit cost, runs it on your images and brings the finished images back into the chat. Every edit is saved as a version you can restore, and teammates with the workflow open see changes live.

positive.prompt: List my Caimera workflows and tell me which ones take a batch of product photos.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the workspace's workflows with links, and names the ones that have a Batch Input.

positive.description: Build a workflow from a description
positive.prompt: Create a Caimera workflow that takes product photos, puts each one on a model in a studio, then upscales the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a workflow with a Batch Input, an Edit / Create Image node and an Upscale node, and returns a link to it on the Caimera canvas. Nothing runs and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Estimate the cost of a run
positive.prompt: How many credits would it cost to run 'On-model studio' on this image: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/0/09/T-shirt.jpg
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the number of runs and the estimated credits without starting a run.

positive.description: Run a workflow and show results
positive.prompt: Run 'On-model studio' on that image and show me the result.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts one run, waits for it to finish and shows the generated image with a link.

positive.prompt: Change the model prompt in 'On-model studio' to an outdoor street scene.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the Edit / Create Image node's prompt and confirms the change, which is saved as a restorable version. Nothing runs and no credits are spent.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: Account and billing changes are not supported
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Caimera plan and add 1,000 credits.
